Forecast run: Tue, Oct 20, 9:43 AM PDT (the page refreshes this a few times a day).
Each hour: time, direction and speed (knots, g = gust), odds of 12kt or more, regime, waves, tide height in ft with r rising or f falling. OUTFLOW NOT RIDDEN = Squamish outflow, never recommend. OFF DIR = direction does not work at that spot.

Guillermo's own take for Tue, Oct 20 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): The northwest is blowing a bit more than the page shows: the English Bay buoy had W 12 gusting 18 at 8am. Jericho could work until about noon, WNW 12 to 15. If the buoy still reads 12+ from the west after 1pm, the afternoon is on too, with a 14ft high tide at 2:52pm.

Tsawwassen’s north side works on NNW once the tide passes 10ft, around 11:30am if you are foiling

Porteau is fading (Pam Rocks 17 at 7am, needs 22). Howe Sound outflow is back tonight, so Porteau could be on early Wednesday.

Track record, last 30 days: Porteau Cove (scored at Pam Rocks): typical miss 3.15kt, caught 51% of windy hours, 15% false alarms; Steveston - Garry Point Park (scored at Sand Heads): typical miss 2.55kt, caught 77% of windy hours, 22% false alarms; Tsawwassen Ferry Terminal Causeway (scored at Tsawwassen Ferry Terminal): typical miss 2.7kt, caught 69% of windy hours, 34% false alarms; Erwin Park (scored at Point Atkinson): typical miss 2.68kt, caught 42% of windy hours, 17% false alarms. Other spots are not measured yet.
